mapper.insert: insert into product_view_log ( view_id, user_id, products_id, view_source, view_count, last_view_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{viewId}, #{userId}, #{productsId}, #{viewSource}, #{viewCount}, #{lastViewTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) on duplicate key update view_count = ifnull(view_count, 0) + values(view_count), view_source = values(view_source), last_view_time = values(last_view_time), update_time = values(update_time)
